# Vidou

> > Vidou is a free AI-powered image-to-video generator that works entirely in the browser with no login required.

Vidou offers AI video and image generation tools with a flexible coin-based pricing model, commercial licensing options, and a privacy-first approach that processes content directly in your browser without storing user data.

## Key Topics

- AI image-to-video generation
- Free video generator
- No login required
- Browser-based processing
- Coin-based pricing
- Commercial license
- Pay-once model
- AI video tools
- AI image tools
- Privacy-first approach
- Google Analytics
- 2025 AI video technology
